propositions: The exact summary executor must route only when tests enable the selector, bypassing generic retry while preserving legacy behavior for mixed fields.

Success dispositions (applied, recovered, already_satisfied) must map to legacy result surface, advance the ADR-0026 baseline with the summary value from the mutation's fields["summary"], and preserve all existing telemetry shapes.

All non-success dispositions (commit_unknown, retryable_deferred, permanent_failure, exhausted_transient, and further terminal dispositions) must record exactly one redacted per-mutation error message capped at 512 Unicode code points, never advance baseline or provenance, and not block unrelated batch work.
The constructor-injected selector must default to legacy, add no config or environment key, and never dual-send.
Terminal outcomes must carry the OperationOutcome retry_not_before value to the manifest for observability only and persist no S1 deferral.
ADR 0103 must name S3 as sole production cutover, fuse/deferral consumer, and bridge-retirement owner.
